**Observed:** The video loads the D&D Beyond Corvo Saggio character sheet, dismisses the cookie notice, and displays the sheet. Near the end, the Print Enhancer interface appears: a left extension panel contains Layout and Output controls, while a right **“LAYER MANAGEMENT”** panel shows a **“SECTIONS (22)”** list and a **“SHAPES (1)”** area with shape entries and small action icons. A banner states that no saved layout is loaded and the default template is used.

**Not visible:** No layer row is opened or manipulated. There is no visible Print Visibility toggle, layer Visibility toggle, lock/unlock action, section reordering, print-preview result, DOM-style change, or print CSS/z-index effect. Consequently, the specified `print_per_layer` interactions and their visible sheet results cannot be witnessed.

### Video 2 — `section_print_order`

**Observed:** The video again loads the Corvo Saggio sheet and reveals the Print Enhancer interface. The right **Layer Management** panel visibly contains a **Sections (22)** list with section cards such as “Corvo Saggio,” “Health,” “Box 2,” “Ability 4,” “Ability 3,” “Ability 2,” “Ability 1,” “Quick Info,” “Extras,” “Features & Traits,” “Inventory,” and several numbered sections. The panel also shows print/screen filters and a Shapes section.

**Not visible:** No section card is dragged. The card order does not visibly change, and there is no visible update to DOM order or print z-index when the top card is moved to the bottom or the last card is moved back to the top. Therefore, the specified `section_print_order` interaction and result are not witnessed.

Across the two videos, the extension panel is present, but the required control actions and end-to-end visible results are not shown.
